justification: Minor: data lists only, no code. Withholds 131 council rules that the councils' own words limit to a small area with no outline in our data: Ashfield E2 section 2.3 (14 rows, 140A Hawthorne Parade), City of Sydney Schedule 6 (103 rows, The Rocks), Woollahra E1 Table 3 (9 rows, listed centres) and E1.8.5 (5 rows, Double Bay Centre). Listed as may-apply by suburb. Applied live with owner approval and row-level backups; the same pattern as #1655.

break_it.scenario: A re-publish re-keys the 14 rows to the Haberfield precinct and serves them again.
break_it.what_happens: Every Haberfield house sees controls for one site again.
break_it.how: The rows are in never_serve.json with text fingerprints, which derive_precinct_keys, gate_rules and enrichment skip, and DQ-148 fails if one is served.

post_merge.manual_verify: The may-apply box for Haberfield is not yet checked in a browser.
